title: La Casa --- Your First Everyday Noun
label: ch:noun-casa
canDo: I can say la casa and tengo una casa, using the article and gender rules I already hold.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C43-casa: produce la casa and tengo una casa, and say what casa meant in Latin.
payoff.note: The chapter adds a noun and no grammar: the article, gender and tener machinery were all in place, and had nothing ordinary to act on.
